name: Privacy-safe shared voice runtime telemetry foundation
acceptanceCriteria: Ordered migrations define voice_sessions, voice_turns, voice_events, and voice_latency_metrics with RLS enabled and restrict event error codes to a finite internal vocabulary.
Telemetry writes are server-owned; permanent authenticated owners may read their own metadata and delete a top-level session tree.
Anon has no table or sequence privileges, anonymous-authenticated sessions fail closed, and cross-user access is denied.
Raw audio, transcript text, prompts, replies, private message content, human-readable client correlation identifiers, and free-form error messages are absent from the schema.
Client reconnect or idempotency correlation uses an opaque UUID.

Event payloads accept only an explicit allowlist of primitive operational keys with bounded types, enums, patterns, numeric ranges, and approved internal error codes; unknown keys, nested values, and arbitrary strings fail closed.
The payload validator is not executable by public, anon, or authenticated roles.
No voice Storage bucket exists until uploader, retention, deletion, isolation, MIME, size, and rollback contracts are approved together.
Static contracts and a rollback-contained live authorization probe exist before production migration approval.

verification.blocker: Run exact-head repository gates, apply both migrations only under separate founder approval, then execute rollback-contained owner/cross-user/anonymous/payload-allowlist/error-code-vocabulary/opaque-ID/cascade proof and Supabase advisors before promotion.

rollout.control: No client or server runtime consumes these tables in Phase 1. Any future relay must map provider or client failures to the approved internal error-code vocabulary before insertion.

rollback: Revert the repository migrations before application. After any approved live application, use a separately reviewed rollback migration only after confirming no runtime consumer or retained evidence depends on the tables.
